Spatial prediction
S3 arrives below Chapel and turns into the A approach; S4
reaches the bridge-facing shoulder beside West Homes. M08
blocks the direct diagonal from the bridge stance to both
A local ascents. A 6×6 m plant footprint is an authoring
assumption.
Follower / support
F at the Chapel edge can follow/trade into A but cannot
simultaneously support a teammate at S4 through M08. The
cistern rim offers crouch preparation with open side
exposure.
Opponent / retreat
An A anchor can yield north around the cistern, or contest
the Chapel approach. Watching Upper Bridge requires a
separate position east of M08 and gives up immediate S3
coverage.
